technique: W8A8 projection GEMMs: activations quantized to fp8 e4m3, CUTLASS cutlass_scaled_mm on fp8 tensor cores
mechanism: The attention/MLP projection GEMMs run at 83-135 TFLOPS including activation quant at T=2048, vs a bf16-MMA register GEMM; about 49 ms faster per 2048-token chunk.
impact: About 83% of IntarsiaML's localeval 16k prefill gap to vLLM. vLLM's Marlin MoE is only 4-5% faster at T=2048, and GDN is at parity with FLA, so neither is the lever.
preconditions: accuracy check: activations quantized, output bits change
transfer_notes: Port as an opt-in GEMM path for the prefill projections only; decode is bandwidth-bound and gains nothing.
source_verified: doc and microbenchmark; vLLM source not read
